title: Microsoft Purview: audit logs for OCR transactions in Exchange and Teams
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and distinguishes documented OCR scanning and unified-audit controls from unpublished details of the planned logs. The only finding is that the checklist asks administrators to manage audit-role assignments without a corresponding controls-table row.
